verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry, usage tracking or data retention is a fair privacy question for a hosted LLM inference API like Groq, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry controls, data-retention settings, or any opt-out mechanism. The docs cover inference features (streaming, tool use, batch, service tiers, LoRA, spend limits), none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
